gloss: body slam; throwing oneself wholeheartedly into something

definitions.gloss: body slam; ramming with one's body; body check
definitions.explanation: Striking an opponent or object by hurling one's whole body against it.

definitions.gloss: tackling something wholeheartedly; an all-out, fearless approach
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, throwing oneself into a task or challenge with one's whole being, holding nothing back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{体当|たいあ}たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To slam one's body into the opponent.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{体当|たいあ}たり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I rammed the door with my body to open it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{体当|たいあ}たり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The player body-checked the opponent and won the ball back.

examples.japanese: {体当|たいあ}たり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧。
examples.english: To take it on with everything you've got.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体当|たいあ}たり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Her wholehearted, all-out performance was praised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{体当|たいあ}たり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頼|たの}もしい→頼もしい：07899_tanomoshii⟧。
examples.english: Though a newcomer, his attitude of tackling any job with all his might is reassuring.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (body) + ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hitting). Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb. Sense 1 is physical; sense 2 is the very common figurative idea of giving something your all without hesitation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体当|たいあ}たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ram with the body
- {体当|たいあ}たり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧: to take on with all one's might
- {体当|たいあ}たり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧: an all-out, fearless performance
